Company Profile

Spinneys 1961 Holding PLC is a United Arab Emirates-based grocery retailer. The Company and its subsidiaries operate grocery retail supermarkets under the Spinneys, Waitrose and Al Fair brands in the UAE and Oman. The Company operates approximately 75 stores. Its subsidiaries include Spinneys Dubai LLC, Al Fair SPC, Spinneys Shj. LTD. CO, Fine Fare Food Market LLC, Spinneys Fresh Food Industries LLC, Spinneys Factories for Bakery Products LLC, Spinneys IP Limited, Finefair Food Market Services Limited, among others.
